summary: QRU Source Verification Gate™ end-to-end verified. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passed against the deployed preview backend. GET /api/decoder/gate-test-critical/verify-source returns match.level='critical' with a real reason (the KR is an internal Factory/standard record under a non-Factory title). GET /api/decoder/b407ef84-295a-4471-a09b-7ba0f7ccb8f2/verify-source returns match.level='ok' with 5 non-empty preview paragraphs and learning_objective. POST /api/decoder/gate-test-critical/create-product WITHOUT override returns HTTP 409 with detail.error='source_verification_failed' + detail.gate.match.level='critical' + detail.message; sending {override_source_gate:false} explicitly is equally blocked; omitting body (default False) is also blocked. Frontend: logged in as demo.admin@qru.com, navigated to /decoder-engine, both fixtures visible in the Manufacturing Ready shelf. PATH 1 (CRITICAL) — clicked ready-item-gate-test-critical, detail-title='AI Literacy K-12 — Family Guide', clicked create-product-btn → source-verification-gate modal opened. gate-critical visible with copy '🔴 Critical Manufacturing Error … Manufacturing is stopped before the first page. Only a super-admin may override.' gate-override-btn visible (red 'Override & Manufacture Anyway'), gate-confirm-btn count=0 (correctly absent), gate-cancel-btn visible, gate-preview present, source panel shows Knowledge Record 'Universal Knowledge Record Standard (STD-UKR-0001)' and DEC-GATETEST. gate-override-btn NOT clicked (per instructions). Cancel closed the modal cleanly, stayed on /decoder-engine — no book created. PATH 2 (OK) — clicked ready-item-b407ef84…, detail-title='Sleep Strengthens Memory by Saving New Learning', clicked create-product-btn → gate-ok visible (green '✓ Source matches intended publication'), gate-confirm-btn visible ('Confirm & Manufacture'), gate-critical count=0, gate-override-btn count=0, gate-preview visible with 6 paragraphs (learning objective + 5 body paras from the decoder). Cancel closed cleanly. Did NOT click gate-confirm-btn to avoid creating an extra book — the presence + wiring of all required elements was fully verified.
critical_code_review_comments: decoder_engine.py create_product: uses require_super_admin, correctly enforces gate BEFORE de.create_product_from_decoder — no book side-effect happens on 409. Good.
book_manufacturing.verify_source is deterministic (no LLM), $0 spend — matches the 'NO AI spend in verify-source' promise. Good.
DecoderEngine.js: openGate() catches errors and toasts, but does NOT reset acting state before finally — actually it does via finally. Good.

gate modal uses onClick on backdrop to setGate(null) when !acting — this could cause an accidental dismiss during confirm; consider disabling backdrop dismissal during the destructive override path. Non-blocking — the two intentional buttons are the primary path.
verify-source route uses get_current_user (any authenticated user can preview the gate) while create-product requires require_super_admin. Consistent with the design (super-admin-only override). OK.
test_credentials: demo.admin@qru.com / qru-demo-admin-2026 — verified working (Administrator role, passes require_super_admin).
seed_data_creation: None. The critical fixture decoder (gate-test-critical / DEC-GATETEST) was pre-seeded by the main agent. gate-override-btn was intentionally NOT clicked and gate-confirm-btn on the legit decoder was intentionally NOT clicked — no new books were manufactured during this test.
